own_solution.law: Tsiolkovsky rocket equation v = u ln(m0/mf) = 3000 ln(3200/800) = 3000 ln 4
assumptions: constant exhaust speed relative to rocket

notes: Base: 3000 * 1.386294 = 4158.88 m/s (4.159 km/s). With a 190 kg payload on the rocket: m0 = 3390 kg, mf = 990 kg, v = 3000 ln(3.424242) = 3000 * 1.230880 = 3692.64 m/s. Burn rate 27 kg/s sets the thrust and burn time (2400/27 = 88.9 s) but cancels from the final speed in field-free space (C). T2DD9 and TB855 both state 27 kg/s. Payload-on-tug and previous-flight sentences are D. T357D and T23F7 carry no mass number.
